integrity: Exact matrix-unit proof, complete sixteen-mask reduction, closed multiplicity polynomials, field-4 and prime-field enumerations with replayable standalone code.

title: Characteristic-three resonance in long adjoint Jordan chains of the \(5\times5\) nilradical
